excerpt_i18n.en: On April 23, 2026, Beijing time, Huawei Qiankun Intelligent Automotive Solutions held the Huawei Qiankun Technology Conference in Beijing under the theme "Safety with Qiankun, Peace of Mind for a Better Journey." The conference debuted new-generation solutions including Huawei Qiankun Intelligent Driving ADS 5, HarmonySpace 6, the AMS three-in-one in-cabin AI multimodal perception system, dual 17.2-inch butterfly dual-link screens, LCoS dual-focal-plane AR-HUD, HUAWEI XPIXEL million-pixel color intelligent headlight module, and HUAWEI XSCENE LCoS in-vehicle projection light engine. Huawei Qiankun Intelligent Driving ADS 5 is designed for autonomous driving. It adopts the WEWA 2.0 architecture, evolving into an AI agent for autonomous driving. The world model in the cloud introduces the "Multi-Agent" mechanism for the first time, increasing training intensity by 10 times. Additionally, the WEWA 2.0 architecture employs online reinforcement learning, enabling "simultaneous generation, learning, and validation," improving training efficiency by 10 times. The vehicle-end world behavior model introduces the safety risk field theory for the first time, using risk heatmaps for real-time decision-making, reducing collision risk by 50%. WEWA 2.0 comprehensively enhances the ability to handle complex scenarios and defensive driving capabilities, laying a solid foundation for advancing toward autonomous driving. Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, released the industry's first Qiankun OS operating system for autonomous driving, focusing on performance and safety.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 23 de abril de 2026, hora de Pekín, Huawei celebró en Pekín la Conferencia de Tecnología Qiankun de Huawei bajo el lema "Seguridad con Qiankun, tranquilidad hacia un futuro mejor", donde presentó las nuevas soluciones de próxima generación, incluyendo Huawei Qiankun Intelligent Driving® ADS 5, HarmonySpace 6, el sistema multimodal de percepción en cabina AMS, la pantalla dual plegable de 17,2 pulgadas, el AR-HUD de doble plano focal LCoS, el módulo de faros inteligentes en color de un millón de píxeles HUAWEI XPIXEL, y el proyector de a bordo LCoS HUAWEI XSCENE. Huawei Qiankun Intelligent Driving® ADS 5 está diseñado para la conducción autónoma.
